name: Milestone with acceptance and stop rules
summary: Every milestone states owner outcome, acceptance evidence, stop/rollback rules.
steps: north star -> milestone (outcome, acceptance, evidence, stop rule) -> tasks -> evidence run -> review -> accept

name: Current-stable adoption
summary: How to move a project to a new STDB release.
steps: compatibility matrix (CLI/server/crate/SDK/toolchain) -> read release notes -> separate pinned install -> copied data, alt port -> functional evidence (two identities, persistence, reconnect) -> rollback plan -> decision record

name: Private playtest
steps: fresh isolated world -> allowlist admission server-side -> reserve the host -> publish pinned build -> smoke with two identities -> invite -> monitor tick_health -> collect feedback -> wind down + backup

name: AI-assisted module change
steps: load rules catalog -> plan tables/reducers -> write -> hallucination check -> cargo check/test -> publish to local -> regen bindings -> client smoke -> review

name: Load test cadence
steps: 10 -> 100 -> 1,000 -> 5,000 bots; each stage must PASS budgets before the next; record hardware and versions

name: Worktree-per-task
summary: Parallel agents without stepping on each other.
steps: one task = one branch + worktree outside the repo; evidence outside repo; merge via review; remove worktree

name: Incident response
steps: check tick_health -> spacetime logs -> identify hot reducer/subscription -> throttle/feature-flag -> hotfix publish (additive) -> postmortem with ADR

name: Backup and restore drill
summary: Prove recovery before players depend on it.
steps: stop or snapshot -> copy data dir/commitlog -> restore on alt port with same binary -> verify row counts and two-identity login

name: Release review
steps: read notes + PRs, classify breaking/perf/features, test in sandbox, update KB facts + pins, publish advisory

name: ADR practice
summary: Record decisions with context and consequences.
steps: ADR per significant choice (topology, auth, AOI, sharding), status proposed->accepted->superseded
